questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Stop and look for other vehicles, then go if there is no traffic.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to clear the intersection quickly.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light tells drivers to slow down and go forward carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn at this location.

questions.question: Ramps and bridges freeze before regular highways and roads.
questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: Ramps and bridges are exposed to air on all sides, so they ice over faster than regular road surfaces. Drive slowly and carefully when crossing bridges in freezing weather.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can cause what problem?

options.text: Require your vehicle to have a tune-up sooner than normal.
Set grass fires on country roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make you drowsy while driving.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases and cools hot gases from the engine. A leak releases dangerous fumes that can make you drowsy and even cause serious harm.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads divided by a barrier or median.

questions.question: When visibility is reduced, your first action should be:

options.text: Look for road edge markings to guide you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Slowing down is the first thing to do when you cannot see well. This helps you stay safe on dangerous roads.

questions.question: You turn onto a two-lane road with a broken yellow line in the center. What does this tell you?

options.text: You are on a two-way road.
You are on a one-way road.
You must stay to the left of the broken yellow lines.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are on a two-way road.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic going in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you can pass when it is safe.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT affect the distance needed to stop your vehicle?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steering ability
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. These change based on your speed and road conditions. Steering ability does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: When can you cross double solid yellow lines?
questions.correctAnswerText: To turn into a driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn left into or out of a driveway, or to enter or exit a highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What best keeps you and others safe when backing up?

options.text: Honk your horn right before shifting into reverse.
Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
Check your rearview mirrors to see what is behind you.
Turn up the car radio before backing up to alert people around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
questions.explanation: Backing up is risky because it is hard to see behind your vehicle. Before you get in and back up, walk to the back of the vehicle to check for children and small objects.

questions.question: What colors are used for warning signs that show upcoming hazards?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on a white background
Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
White letters or symbols on a blue background
White letters or symbols on a green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. Work zone warning signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: Before turning left, you should:

options.text: Swing to the right side of your lane.
Wait until oncoming traffic has a red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: When turning left at a traffic signal, you must let pedestrians and oncoming traffic go first.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in business zones?
questions.correctAnswerText: 25 mph.
questions.explanation: Unless a sign shows otherwise, the speed limit for cars and motorcycles in business, residential, or school areas is 25 mph.

questions.question: Highway signs that require drivers to follow an instruction are called:
questions.correctAnswerText: Regulatory signs.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs require drivers to follow an instruction. You can get a penalty for not obeying them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will make a sharp turn to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show direction and distance information.
questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs are green and show direction and distance to specific places. They are helpful when you are driving in an unfamiliar area.

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows to control turns from certain lanes. A solid red arrow means:

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a circular red traffic light.
You may turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic in the arrow's direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a circular red traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a regular red traffic light. When you see a red arrow, you must stop and cannot turn in that direction.

questions.question: It is safe to use cruise control on snowy or icy roads if you reduce your speed.
questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snowy or icy roads. Your tires may lose grip and you will lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: Which recommendation does NOT help with safe night driving?

options.text: Know that tinted windows make it harder to see in the dark.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look directly at the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look directly at the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: Looking at oncoming headlights makes your pupils shrink. After the vehicle passes, your eyes need time to adjust back to the darker light. During this time, you cannot see well.

questions.question: When driving in bad weather, drivers should:

options.text: Speed up to get to their destination faster.
Follow the car in front more closely.
Stay farther back from the car in front.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther back from the car in front.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, increase the distance between your vehicle and the car in front of you.

questions.question: The traffic light turns from green to yellow as you approach the intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Treat it like a caution sign and keep going through the intersection.
Stop before entering the intersection, unless you are too close to stop safely.
Speed up to get through before the light turns red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection, unless you are too close to stop safely.
questions.explanation: When you see a yellow light, slow down and stop before you enter the intersection if you can do so safely. If you cannot stop safely, drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: A leaky exhaust system is dangerous because it can cause:
questions.correctAnswerText: Carbon monoxide poisoning.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system pushes harmful gases out of your vehicle. A leak lets these gases enter the passenger area. Fix any exhaust leaks right away to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning.

questions.question: When you see a green arrow at a traffic signal, you:

options.text: Should merge into the lane that points in the direction of the arrow.
Should slow down and stop if it is safe.
May turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians pass first.
May drive straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians pass first.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane for the turn. Let any vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection go first.

questions.question: Your vehicle is in an accident and is blocking traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Move your vehicle off the road if you can.
Do not move your vehicle under any circumstances.
Wait for police to arrive before moving it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle off the road if you can.
questions.explanation: After a minor accident, move your vehicle off the road if possible. Stay at the scene and identify yourself to help others.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on green must let oncoming traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on green must let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left on a green light, they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: If there are two railroad tracks next to each other:

options.text: It is always safe to cross after one train passes.
You must always stop before crossing.
After one train passes, check for a train on the other track before crossing.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: After one train passes, check for a train on the other track before crossing.
questions.explanation: With two side-by-side tracks, watch for another train after one passes. Don't cross until you are sure no train is coming from either direction on either track.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points straight down, they are signaling that they will stop. Adjust your driving if you are following a driver using this signal.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, which way should you turn your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: On a downhill slope, turn your wheels toward the road's edge. If your vehicle rolls, it will move away from traffic.
